# Archived Lane F raw evidence

Owner decision, 2026-10-19: remove the E1–E6 raw captures and the C1/C2 raw-evidence
hash inventories from the main tree. These historical captures and inventories have
no remaining automatic reader; the operator-run campaign driver can still read them
when restored. Verdicts, tables, frozen values, stage documents and comparison inputs stay.
The two source-record paths in `E/values.json` now link to the tag; measured values are unchanged.

The complete pre-cleanup tree is preserved at `archive/machinery-cleanup-base`
(commit `22ec5127f`). [Browse the archived evidence](https://github.com/justsearch-app/justsearch/tree/archive/machinery-cleanup-base/docs/design/lane-f-engine-jvm/evidence),
or restore a repository-relative path with:

```sh
git checkout archive/machinery-cleanup-base -- <path>
```

The 101 removed files total 130,409,993 bytes. This inventory
records SHA-256, byte size and path relative to this evidence directory. Generate it
from the archive tag at the repository root with:

```sh
python3 - <<'PYTHON'
import hashlib, subprocess
base = 'archive/machinery-cleanup-base'
prefix = 'docs/design/lane-f-engine-jvm/evidence/'
targets = [prefix + 'E/' + d for d in
           ['e1-quality', 'e2-e3-load', 'e4-memory-soak', 'e5-crash', 'e6-hang']]
targets += [prefix + c + '/raw-evidence-sha256.json' for c in ['C1', 'C2']]
for p in subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', base,
                                  '--', *targets], text=True).splitlines():
    data = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{base}:{p}'])
    print(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), len(data), p.removeprefix(prefix))
PYTHON
```
